**Finding: deviation (high severity, LD rule)**

- **Where:** § 3.4(b) Termination for Convenience (p0046), cross-referenced in § 3.3 (p0042).
- **Issue:** Our convenience-termination right is conditioned on paying unquantified "early termination charges" specified in Attachment A and Service Option Attachments — a Customer-payable liquidated amount with no cap, made worse by § 13.1 letting IBM unilaterally change Attachment A terms on notice.
- **Checked and clear:** § 4.2 refers only to late payment fees; § 9.2 limits Customer liability to actual direct damages; no other Customer-payable penalty or minimum-fee mechanic appears (no "liquidated damages" language anywhere in the document).
- **Redline (validated, preferred):** replaces 3.4(b) so we pay only charges accrued through the termination date and expressly owe no early termination charge, penalty, liquidated damages, or unearned minimum; the comment offers the fallback of a charge capped at three months' recurring charges if IBM insists.
